summary: Primoris Services Corp filed an 8-K/A (Amendment No. 2) solely to correct clerical errors in the exhibit titles of its prior earnings press release and related amendments. The original 8-K, filed August 4, 2026, reported results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, and the company declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.08 per share, payable October 15, 2026, to stockholders of record September 30, 2026. These are routine operational and financial disclosures with no special-situation corporate event. The amendment contains no changes to the underlying disclosures beyond correcting mislabeled period headings, and the dividend declaration is a standard recurring capital return. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situations activity is indicated.
